# AncestralFire: reading a life

Their family is in AncestralFire's tools, through this plugin's AncestralFire connector (its MCP server is ancestralfire). The ancestralfire skill says how to talk with them and how the tools are laid out.

- Person takes an id, a relation or a name as they said it; and adds up to 7 more people in the same read. The answer is told from that answer; what it held back is read with the call held_back gives, and section "written" reads what the family wrote, page by page.
- The relation is the one the answer gives, never counted again.
- Children or grandchildren, counted or listed, are one read: Family (view line, direction descendants, generations 2). How two people connect is Family (view relationship).
- Their ancestors by generation: Family (view line, id). A life on a map: Place (mode map, kind life, person_id).
- A name in Chinese, Japanese or Korean characters is a person in their file, with their clan seat, courtesy name and art name where the file holds them; a famous name in their tree is the person in their file.
